verdict.rationale: JumpCloud publishes a versioned API specification: the API 2.0 doc is hosted at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml and describes its RESTful endpoints. However, the versioning is only implied by that URL path, and no deprecation policy, sunset timeline or version-lifecycle documentation appears anywhere in the evidence. Probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI file at standard paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning documentation (version lifecycle, changelog, v1 vs v2 support status), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
